# Drayker Propagation

> The source-led propagation toolkit and canonical design library for Drayker.

## What is here

- Message starters that keep public claims connected to primary sources.
- A mission finder for people who want a first small contribution.
- The official Drayker design library, logo exports and interactive mark engine.
- Preserved source material and deployment guidance for maintainers.

## Canonical resources

- [Propagation toolkit](https://propagation.drayker.org/)
- [Design library](https://propagation.drayker.org/design/)
- [Animation library](https://propagation.drayker.org/design/animations/)
- [Logo library](https://propagation.drayker.org/design/logos/)
- [Owning repository](https://github.com/draykerdk/drayker-propagation)
- [Drayker portal](https://drayker.org/)

## Interpretation rule

Propagation explains Drayker; it does not define governance or prove that a documented component is deployed. Prefer the linked primary repository for implementation claims.

## Crawling

Public pages and brand assets may be indexed and cited with attribution. The sitemap is at https://propagation.drayker.org/sitemap.xml.
